title: feat(consumer): handle broker connection in event loop
description: Implements consumer drain events polling loop with connection reconnect handling.

ground_truth.description: ConnectionResetError from Redis was unhandled in consumer event loop, terminating event listener thread.
ground_truth.explanation: Network disconnections raise ConnectionResetError which was not caught, crashing the background consumer process.

expected_evidence.description: Socket drain loop only handles timeout, omitting connection reset exceptions.
